native_mechanisms: Lay the two symbol strings crosswise over a tray so their crossings form a lattice of scored meeting-points (the DP grid).

A single one-cell agent walks all eight directions, deposits a score-mound at each junction, overwrites any weaker standing mound, and curls back over its own trail to re-test junctions from another face until no junction anywhere can be improved — no ledger except the mounds themselves.
A sideways crossing costs nothing, letting one cord slip a step ahead of the other (a free gap / zero-cost indel).
core_technique: Exact Needleman-Wunsch computed by an anti-diagonal (wavefront) sweep with three rolling diagonals, SIMD-vectorized in 16-bit lanes (AVX2/AVX-512) with a reversed second sequence, plus 32-bit and scalar row-DP fallbacks — a standard diagonal-major vectorization of the textbook O(n^2) DP.
